paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: This line plot, titled "Prompt Depth vs Accuracy," illustrates the relationship between prompt depth (measured in Joules, J) and model accuracy (expressed as a percentage, %) for two models: 'mmsd' and 'mmsd2'. The x-axis, labeled "Prompt Depth (J)", spans from 2 to 10 Joules with major tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 74% to 81% with major gridlines and tick marks at 1% intervals. The 'mmsd' model, represented by an orange dashed line with square markers, begins at approximately 80.1% accuracy at a prompt depth of 2 J, rises to a peak of 81.3% at 9 J, and then slightly declines to 80.1% at 10 J. The 'mmsd2' model, represented by a blue solid line with circular markers, starts at 76.5% accuracy at 2 J, drops to a minimum of 74.0% at 3 J, then increases steadily to 77.6% at 8 J, and finally slightly decreases to 76.9% at 10 J.
